note: rachat prévu des billets 4,625 % 2023 de Brocade (filiale acquise) vers le 16 janvier 2018 ; montant non publié dans le bloc
quote: The Company intends to cause Brocade to provide notice to the trustee of Brocade's 4.625% Senior Notes due 2023 ("Senior Notes") of its intent to effect the repurchase of the Senior Notes on or about January 16, 2018
